summary: Iteration 6 — regression check for the production-URL safety net added to /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts (`BASE = !__DEV__ && RAW_BASE.includes('.preview.emergentagent.com') ? RAW_BASE.replace('.preview…','.emergent.host') : RAW_BASE`). Because preview is __DEV__ === true, the conditional short-circuits and RAW_BASE is used unchanged — the fix must be invisible here, which is exactly what was verified. Frontend-only run on 390×844 mobile viewport against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://media-vault-api.preview.emergentagent.com. ALL requested flows PASS: (1) Register new user iter6c_1786720069@gmail.com via register-email-input/register-password-input/register-submit-button → home-screen. (2) Onboarding — login-goto-register from login → onboarding-screen loaded, advanced through all 5 slides via onboarding-next, onboarding-skip → register-screen (also independently verified skip route). (3) Logout — profile-logout-button (reached by tapping the 'Profile' tab; note: tabBarTestID='tab-profile' does not render as data-testid on RN-Web so text tap is used) → login-screen. (4) Wrong password — login-error shows exactly 'Invalid credentials' (non-blank, backend detail propagated by hardened client). (5) Login with correct creds → home-screen. (6) Regression — home-screen loads, tab-library shows library-screen with filter chips, home-add-fab opens add-discovery-screen, add-mode-text + add-text-input='Interstellar (2014)' + add-submit-button → add-saved-banner 'Auto-saved 1 title(s) to your library' and movie-detail-screen renders REAL TMDB data (rating 8.5, 169m runtime, 'Directed by Christopher Nolan', cast McConaughey/Hathaway/Chastain/Affleck, genres Adventure/Drama/Science Fiction, watch providers Amazon Prime/Hulu/Paramount+ with logos). Zero page errors, zero red screens. Only console errors are expected pre-auth 401 on /home ('Missing bearer token') and RN-Web cosmetic warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) — all carry-over from prior iterations. The preview code path of client.ts is regression-free after the added production rewrite branch.

action_items: None blocking — /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts change is safe to ship (preview path untouched, prod rewrite gated on __DEV__ === false).
(Optional) Add explicit testID to bottom tabs via `tabBarButton` on RN-Web so tab-profile/tab-library/tab-home are queryable via data-testid.

(Reminder to main agent) The production URL-rewrite branch (line 12–14 of client.ts) CANNOT be exercised in the preview environment — only a production build (__DEV__ === false) with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL still pointing at *.preview.emergentagent.com will trigger it. Verify in a real prod bundle that: (a) RAW_BASE includes '.preview.emergentagent.com' → BASE ends in '.emergent.host', and (b) if the prod env var already points at '.emergent.host' the includes() check is false and BASE is used as-is (no double-rewrite).
critical_code_review_comments: client.ts BASE derivation is safe: the `.replace('.preview.emergentagent.com', '.emergent.host')` is a first-match string replace, and because the source substring is unique in the URL (host segment only) there is no risk of accidentally rewriting a path/query. Good.
Rewrite is gated on `!__DEV__` so preview/dev is 100% unaffected — the empirical regression run confirms this.

The condition uses `.includes('.preview.emergentagent.com')` which is correct even if RAW_BASE has a trailing path; however if a future prod URL happened to contain '.preview.emergentagent.com' as a substring the rewrite would still fire. Acceptable given the closed set of Emergent hostnames.
No hardcoded production URL — the target host is DERIVED from the preview URL via .replace(), which satisfies the safety-net requirement without leaking prod hostnames into the bundle.
